Package neqsim.pvtsimulation.util

Class PVTFluidStudy

java.lang.Object
neqsim.pvtsimulation.util.PVTFluidStudy
public final class PVTFluidStudy extends Object
Reproducible fluid-model capture, PVT experiments and bounded E300 delivery checks.

All calculations operate on independent serialized copies. The native snapshot is the exact NeqSim model checkpoint; the human-readable parameter inventory and E300 file have explicitly narrower contracts. E300 qualification is limited to the declared temperature/pressure grid and experiments, and does not establish agreement with laboratory measurements or another simulator.

  • Method Details

    • configureViscosity

      public static void configureViscosity(SystemInterface fluid, String model)
      Configure the declared hydrocarbon viscosity model across current and latent gas/oil property slots.

      Each allocated phase owns separate physical-property objects for gas and oil. Configuring only its current type leaves the other object's default active after a subsequent phase-type change. This method is intended for initial study-model construction, before transport coefficients are tuned.

      Parameters:
      fluid - initialized study fluid to configure
      model - explicit LBC or PFCT viscosity model
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the fluid or model is unsupported
